title.zh: SemiAnalysis拿206项专业任务考AI：Opus 5.5夺冠也仅得12分
title.en: SemiAnalysis拿206项专业任务考AI：Opus 5.5夺冠也仅得12分

current_state.zh: SemiAnalysis and 14 data partners launched GDPx, a 206-task benchmark spanning 11 professional domains in which the top model, Claude Opus 5.5, scored just 12/100, all models failed strict finance and legal tasks outright, and agents violated operating rules in 196 of 200 simulated penetration tests.
